examples.en: I am looking for the engineer who owns the billing alerts.
examples.zh: 我在找负责计费告警的那个工程师。

situation.en: I'm looking for a simpler way to test this without the full stack.
situation.zh: 评审时你说你在找更简单的测试办法。

examples.en: Could you look over this design before I share it with the team?
examples.zh: 我把这个设计发给团队之前，你能先过目一下吗？

situation.en: I'll look over the numbers tonight and flag anything odd.
situation.zh: 你答应今晚帮同事检查一遍数据。

examples.en: I looked through the old tickets, but nobody had reported this before.
examples.zh: 我把旧工单都翻了一遍，之前没人报过这个问题。

situation.en: Look through the changelog — the breaking change is in there somewhere.
situation.zh: 你让同事在变更日志里翻一下。

examples.en: Look out for flaky tests after the upgrade — they always show up.
examples.zh: 升级后要留意不稳定的测试，它们总会冒出来。

situation.en: Look out for a confirmation email in the next hour.
situation.zh: 你提醒用户留意确认邮件。

examples.en: We collected feedback for months but never acted on it.
examples.zh: 我们收集了几个月的反馈，却从没据此行动过。

situation.en: Let's act on the retro items this time, not just list them.
situation.zh: 复盘后你强调这次要真的落实。

entries.zh: 根据（建议、信息）采取行动

examples.en: The proposal lays out three options with their trade-offs.
examples.zh: 这个提案把三个选项和各自的取舍都摆清楚了。

situation.en: Let me lay out the plan for the next two quarters.
situation.zh: 规划会开始时你先把计划全盘托出。

entries.zh: 摆开、清楚地阐明（计划、方案）

examples.en: Let me talk it over with my team before I commit to a date.
examples.zh: 我先和团队商量一下，再承诺日期。

situation.en: Can we talk over the on-call changes before Friday?
situation.zh: 你想约同事商量值班调整的事。

examples.en: The talk touched on observability but never went into detail.
examples.zh: 那次分享提到了可观测性，但没有展开讲。

situation.en: I'll touch on testing at the end if we have time.
situation.zh: 你做分享预告时会简单带过测试话题。

examples.en: You have not thought through what happens when the cache is cold.
examples.zh: 你还没想清楚缓存冷启动时会发生什么。

situation.en: Let me think it through tonight and answer tomorrow.
situation.zh: 面试被问到难点，你说想一晚再答。

entries.zh: 想透彻、把后果都想清楚

examples.en: Think over the offer for a few days — there is no rush.
examples.zh: 用几天好好考虑这个 offer，不用急。

situation.en: I'll think it over and let you know on Monday.
situation.zh: 对方给了你一个提议，你说考虑一下周一回复。

examples.en: Do not throw away the old config — we might need it for the rollback.
examples.zh: 别把旧配置扔了，回滚时可能用得上。

situation.en: We can throw away the prototype; it served its purpose.
situation.zh: 你提议把原型代码废弃掉。

examples.en: We used up the whole error budget in the first week of the month.
examples.zh: 月初第一周我们就用光了全部错误预算。

situation.en: We've used up the free tier on that service.
situation.zh: 你向经理汇报某个服务的免费额度用完了。

examples.en: Legal wrote off the old laptops as fully depreciated.
examples.zh: 法务把旧笔记本按全额折旧核销了。

entries.note: write off 也常指“认为没希望而放弃”：write off the whole afternoon 把一下午当作白费了。

situation.en: Don't write off the old system yet — it still handles half the traffic.
situation.zh: 你提醒同事别急着宣判老系统死刑。

entries.zh: 核销、注销；认定没用而放弃

examples.en: I mocked up the new dashboard in an afternoon to get feedback early.
examples.zh: 我用一个下午把新仪表盘的原型拼了出来，好早点拿反馈。

situation.en: Mock it up first — we can argue about pixels once it exists.
situation.zh: 你建议先做原型再讨论细节。

examples.en: We still need to nail down the launch date with marketing.
examples.zh: 我们还得和市场部把发布日期敲定。

situation.en: Let's nail down the scope today, no more maybes.
situation.zh: 你催团队把范围定死、别再含糊。

examples.en: We kicked off the project with a two-hour planning session.
examples.zh: 我们用一场两小时的规划会启动了这个项目。

entries.note: 名词 kickoff：a project kickoff 项目启动会。源自橄榄球开球。

situation.en: We'll kick off the migration on Monday morning.
situation.zh: 你宣布迁移周一早上开始。

examples.en: It is hard to keep track of who owns which service in a spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 用电子表格很难跟得清每个服务归谁。

situation.en: I keep track of my tasks in a plain text file.
situation.zh: 闲聊工具时你说你怎么管理待办。

examples.en: We will make do with the current servers until the new ones arrive.
examples.zh: 新服务器到之前，我们先凑合用现在的。

situation.en: No whiteboard? We'll make do with the glass wall.
situation.zh: 开会发现没白板，你说拿玻璃墙凑合。

examples.en: After three failed startups, he finally made it as a consultant.
examples.zh: 三次创业失败之后，他终于作为顾问干成了。

entries.note: make it 三个高频义：成功、赶上（make it to the meeting）、活下来。

situation.en: Sorry, I can't make it on Friday — family commitment.
situation.zh: 同事约你周五聚，你说去不了。

entries.zh: 成功做成；赶到、参加得了

examples.en: I got in touch with the vendor about renewing the contract.
examples.zh: 我联系了供应商谈续约的事。

situation.en: Get in touch if the problem comes back.
situation.zh: 你对用户说有问题再联系。

examples.en: The whole team gets together for lunch on the last Friday of the month.
examples.zh: 每月最后一个周五，全团队一起吃午饭。

situation.en: Let's get together next week and plan the offsite.
situation.zh: 你提议下周聚一下筹划团建。

examples.en: Error rates go down every time we add a cache layer.
examples.zh: 每次加一层缓存，错误率就会下降。

entries.note: go down 也是系统宕机的口头说法：The site went down. 网站挂了。

situation.en: If the site goes down during the sale, we lose real money.
situation.zh: 你强调大促期间宕机的后果。

examples.en: Costs go up every year, but the budget stays flat.
examples.zh: 成本年年涨，预算却不动。

situation.en: Traffic usually goes up after the newsletter goes out.
situation.zh: 你解释流量规律。

examples.en: The alarm went off twice last night, both false positives.
examples.zh: 昨晚告警响了两次，都是误报。

entries.note: go off 义项多：闹钟响、灯熄灭、食物变质、（人对某事）没兴趣了。靠语境区分。

situation.en: My phone alarm goes off at six thirty.
situation.zh: 闲聊作息：你的闹钟六点半响。

examples.en: While I was presenting, the screen sharing went on showing my notes.
examples.zh: 我演示的时候，屏幕共享一直还露着我的笔记。

entries.note: go on 还表“发生”：What's going on? 出什么事了？以及演讲时的“请继续”：Go on。

situation.en: Go on — I'm listening.
situation.zh: 同事讲到一半停了，你示意他继续。

examples.en: Let me check when the office network goes out — the lights are flickering.
examples.zh: 办公室的灯在闪，我看看是不是要断电了。

entries.note: go out 日常高频义是“出去玩”：go out for dinner。灯、火熄灭也是它。

situation.en: We go out as a team once a quarter.
situation.zh: 你介绍团队活动。

entries.zh: 出去（社交、吃饭）；（灯、火）熄灭

examples.en: As time goes by, the old screenshots in the doc matter less and less.
examples.zh: 随着时间流逝，文档里的旧截图越来越不重要了。

situation.en: Two hours went by before anyone noticed the outage.
situation.zh: 你讲故障：两个小时过去了才有人发现。

examples.en: She handed out a one-page summary at the start of the workshop.
examples.zh: 研讨会一开始她就给每人发了一页摘要。

situation.en: I'll hand out the printed architecture diagram now.
situation.zh: 开会时你说要发打印出来的架构图。

examples.en: Hang on — let me check that number before we move on.
examples.zh: 等一下，我先核对那个数字再继续。

situation.en: Hang on, that contradicts what we saw yesterday.
situation.zh: 讨论中你听出矛盾，插一句等一下。

examples.en: Hold on to the old invoices until finance confirms the migration.
examples.zh: 在财务确认迁移完成前，先留着旧发票。

situation.en: Hold on to that idea — it might work for the mobile app.
situation.zh: 你让同事先把那个想法留着。

examples.en: You learn to live with some legacy code — not everything gets rewritten.
examples.zh: 你会学着和一些遗留代码共处，不是所有东西都能重写。

situation.en: I can live with the naming, but not with the missing tests.
situation.zh: 评审时你表明哪些能忍、哪些不能。

entries.zh: 忍受、与（不完美的事物）共处

examples.en: I log in with my company account, never my personal one.
examples.zh: 我用公司账号登录，从不用个人账号。

entries.note: 名词是 login（一个词）或 log-in；形容词也是 login page。log on 与 log in 基本同义。

situation.en: You need to log in before the dashboard shows your projects.
situation.zh: 你指导新同事使用内部系统。

examples.en: Remember to log out on shared machines — someone left theirs open last week.
examples.zh: 记得在公用电脑上退出登录，上周就有人没退。

situation.en: The app logs you out after thirty minutes idle.
situation.zh: 你向用户说明自动登出的规则。

examples.en: We are meeting up with the design team after the conference.
examples.zh: 会议结束后我们要和设计组碰个面。

situation.en: Let's meet up at the venue entrance at nine.
situation.zh: 你约同行的人在会场门口碰头。

examples.en: He nodded off during the long compliance training.
examples.zh: 在漫长的合规培训上他打起了瞌睡。

situation.en: I keep nodding off in afternoon meetings after big lunches.
situation.zh: 你自嘲午饭吃多了下午开会犯困。

examples.en: Our team lead's father passed away last week, so she is on leave.
examples.zh: 我们组长的父亲上周去世了，她在休假。

entries.note: pass away 是委婉说法，正式场合和慰问时用它；口语直接说 died 也不失礼，看场合。

situation.en: I'm sorry to hear your grandfather passed away.
situation.zh: 同事的家人去世了，你表达慰问。

examples.en: It took me a few months to settle down in the new city.
examples.zh: 我花了几个月才在新城市安顿下来。

situation.en: Once the kids settle down, we can talk about the plan.
situation.zh: 家里很吵，你说等孩子们安静下来再聊。

examples.en: Let me start off by thanking everyone who helped with the launch.
examples.zh: 先让我感谢一下所有帮忙上线的人。

situation.en: I'll start off with the incident timeline.
situation.zh: 你宣布复盘会先从时间线讲起。

examples.en: To sum up: the plan is sound, the date is not.
examples.zh: 总结一下：方案没问题，日期不行。

situation.en: Sum it up in one sentence for the exec summary.
situation.zh: 你让同事把结论压缩成一句话。

examples.en: She takes after her mother — same calm way of handling a crisis.
examples.zh: 她像她妈妈，处理危机时一样沉稳。

situation.en: You take after your mentor, in a good way.
situation.zh: 你夸同事做事风格像他的导师。
